g.text: Missed CNI DEL versus Kubernetes API outage | implemented contract
Explanatory implemented path; dedicated operational acceptance is incomplete.
The agent/speaker restart profiles do not inject these two scenarios.

complete observations, journal state and exact path receipts.
Orphan cleanup is not an unconditional BGP withdrawal command.
No withdrawal, adoption or cleanup authority from API error,
